messages.subject: Order L-37275
messages.text:
Good morning 

I am writing in regards to an order I placed this last June. I ordered two seed bomb 10 packs of five different milkweed varieties. Unfortunately only the Common Milkweed variety produced any germination, I'd say ~80%. The only other germination I got was one each from the Swamp and Utah bombs. Nothing from anyone the Prairie or Butterfly. 

Is there any guarantee policy available to replace and enable me to retry the products next spring?

Thank you 

Paul Fitzgerald 

Hermantown MN
